fact: POTRAZ's Director General stated on 24 January 2026 that Zimbabwe has no standalone cyber crimes act, and that cybercrime offences (hacking, data interference, cyber-bullying, child abuse material and others, ss.163-168) are in force in Part VIII of the Criminal Law (Codification and Reform) Act [Chapter 9:23], as amended in 2021.

fact: A POTRAZ official said Zimbabwe's Cybersecurity Act incorporates cybercrime definitions alongside cybersecurity provisions in one piece of legislation.

POTRAZ's advocacy and compliance manager says cyber offences are contained in the Criminal Law (Codification and Reform) Act Chapter 9:23 as amended by the Cyber and Data Protection Act (Chapter 12:07) of 2021, with no stand-alone cybercrimes Act.

Zimbabwe's Cyber and Data Protection Act [Chapter 12:07] (Act No. 5 of 2021), gazetted in consolidated form on 11 March 2022, amends sections 162 to 166 of the Criminal Law Act to add cyber offences such as transmitting a false data message intending to cause harm (s.164C) and designates POTRAZ as the data protection authority.
